name: Back-2-Top
description: Adds a configurable, vanilla-JavaScript back-to-top button that appears on long pages.
project_description: Back-2-Top adds a small, dependency-free (vanilla JavaScript) back-to-top button that is attached site-wide via hook_page_attachments() and appears once the page is taller than the viewport and the user has scrolled down; clicking it smoothly animates the window back to the top. In the 4.0.x source the button is a dynamically created <button class="back-2-top"> element (not a block or a #toTop div) whose behaviour lives in js/back_2_top.js and whose styling lives in css/back_2_top.css. A single admin settings form (Back2TopSettingsForm, route back_2_top.settings at /admin/config/user-interface/back-2-top, gated by 'administer site configuration') writes the back_2_top.settings config object and controls: on/off (enabled), corner position (bottom-left / bottom-center / bottom-right), background color, opacity, size in pixels, the button glyph (built-in triangle / chevron / arrow, or a custom uploaded image), and whether the button also shows on admin routes (show_on_admin). A custom image is stored as a managed file under public://back_2_top/ and cleaned up on uninstall. The module declares no dependencies and makes no external requests.
